In the studio, presenter Ahmed Mudawi welcomes Oliver Eadsforth, a passionate advocate for deaf football who works with the England and Great Britain teams, supporting players and helping develop the game on and off the pitch. Oliver reflects on his lifelong love of football, from playing goalkeeper at school and university to taking on roles in administration, player development and international football. He discusses the progress made in deaf sport, the importance of having a voice in decision-making and why more opportunities are needed for deaf people to become coaches and leaders.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael's exploration of Essex is drawing to a close. He visits Colchester, which was first mentioned in AD 77 and proudly claims to be Britain’s oldest recorded town. He learns about the rebellion in AD 60 by the warrior queen Boudica against the Romans and visits the Norman castle that was built on top of the foundations of the Temple of Claudius. At the University of Essex’s plant innovation centre, Michael meets scientists growing climate-resistant plants in a state-of-the-art laboratory, where the weather can be changed at will. Across the Chappel viaduct, one the largest in the country, Michael reaches north Essex. He is bound for the Colne Valley heritage railway and learns the history of the line which ran from Chappel and Wakes Colne to Haverhill in Suffolk. He finishes his tour of Essex by driving an old Intercity 125 high-speed train through the picturesque countryside.

programme.desc: Educational series using Makaton sign language. Justin and his friends go for a haircut today, while Mr Tumble has lots of messy fun pretending to be a hairdresser.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: During the Tiddlytubbies' Sleepybyes, RuRu is wide awake. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po take it in turns to sing him a lullaby. When the Teletubbies sing the lullaby together, it sends RuRu off to sleep.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Roman, Rose-May, Zachary, Thomas, Finley, Ferne and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! In this episode we meet a new friend, Baby Tiger. There are scarves inside everyone’s bags which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate scarves inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The baby song Scarves Are Waving! features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: I Spy, You Spy
programme.desc: Elsee visits a dentist and plays I-spy with her new friend Shanaya.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Triggs has lost his woof and needs to visit the vet. Maddie feels a little scared for her buddy, her song just doesn’t sound right without him. But luckily, a new friend and his enormous collection of animals reassures her that everything will be okay.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Murphi and Rebecca’s ghostly makes include a card tube bat, messy ogres and a witch. The Recycling Express provides some empty cardboard boxes to make a huge, spooky house.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion
programme.desc: Raa Raa finds it really funny that all his friends come running every time he roars really loudly. The other jungle inhabitants are less amused, as they only come because there are worried about their friend. What is Raa Raa to do when he gets into trouble and nobody comes to his rescue?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It's an adventure on the high seas as Bluey, Bingo and Missy play pirates on the hammock swing. They'll need to find their courage to withstand storms and whale attacks.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: James finds out all about some very cool sea creatures – starfish. Chantelle is with Dawood to investigate different types of starfish – one with chocolate chips and another that looks like a cushion. Rory and his son Sandy are on Longniddry Beach looking in rockpools for starfish and seastars. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files explain about the shape of starfish, how long they can live and how starfish stop other creatures eating them. It’s also time to find out why they are an important keystone species. This episode’s Teeny Tiny Task is to help the beach and the creatures by litter picking.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Iona and Elba create a pretend ice cream shop and make Mum a heart-shaped ice cream cake. Then it’s time for some real ice cream with plenty of sprinkles for decoration. On a family walk in the woods, Iona and Elba discover a trail of fairy clues to follow. They find fairy treats and magic wands, but will the spells they cast work on Mum and Dad?

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: The chefs are getting ready for a wedding, and Jen is wearing her prized hat. Sunny Sun comes to visit, Small flies off to see how ketchup is made, and the two chefs cook a sweet-and-sour hat for their beaming guest.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Rayane, Karim and Luca are having a sleepover, when hearing dog Diesel is woken in the middle of the night by a strange hissing noise. Is there a slithery snake in the kitchen?

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet some colourful characters - the amazing mandrills, which are the largest species of monkey in the world. They get close enough to see the beautiful blue and red faces of the males. Next, Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet sand lizards. They are surrounded by many females, who blend in perfectly with their sandy home, as well as some colourful males, who are much easier to spot. Finally, Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the wild connection is between these two incredible animals.

programme.title: What’s in Your Bag?
programme.desc: Civil engineer Mimi shows us how she keeps buildings safe by using her clever calliper to measure any cracks.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona tries to teach Baba how to be a grown-up puffin.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Sonny can’t fit a rescued old tin bath into his caravan. Can TapTap find an unexpected use for it?

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Lu wants Biba to play only with her at Shell School today.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Wilf asks the Piggies to build a vehicle with a big basket - he wants to use it to steal all the gifts at the Fine Forest party! The Piggies must get them back.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Ten turns up to tell the Numberblocks what it's like to be a perfect ten. Learn all about the number 10 with Numberblock Ten.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. A makes friends with a cat but soon starts sneezing and bouncing all over. Her friends try to help, but everything they do only makes things worse. How can she sneak away from the cat? This episode has fun with the letters A, C, P, T and N and the words cat, can, pat, tap, cap, nap and dog.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: It’s showtime! Justin and his friends put on a play, whilst Mr Tumble has a go at making a puppet theatre. But managing all his actors proves harder than he thought.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The Teletubbies go on a day trip to the Hidey Hup. They take turns on the Tubby Bouncy, the Tubby Slidey and the Tubby Spinny, before they go on the Tubby Uppy Downy together.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Bahati the zebra has an itch she just can’t scratch, so her friends try to help. Hamza discovers wild buffalo and visits some thirsty elephants.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Maddie is at a shopping centre. She uses special cameras to find out how an escalator works to move people from one floor to another. An animation shows the hidden cogs and chains inside the escalator which make the steps move. Next, Maddie visits a factory to see how wheelbarrows are made from metal sheets to help people move heavy things around outside. She attaches a special camera to a big robot to see it working.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies' very own motorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing machines that all help to build things. Grace drives a backhoe loader and gets to dig a hole, shows off an incredible bridge builder and then fills a hole using a concrete mixer truck!

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: It’s a new day, and Mrs Farrell is checking in with all the children to see how they are. Lucas tells her he is looking for more friends to play with, and there are lots of volunteers! Isla, Otto and Jud bake some delicious tiger ginger biscuits, using coloured icing for roar-some decorations. At playtime, Jud asks if she can play with Lucas, and they have a fun-filled game of chase. The day ends with carpet-time, and Lucas is happy with his new-found friends.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Audrey makes friends with lots of animals on a trip to a farm.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger encounters an injured Mamma Pea-Rex, who quickly befriends the baby Pea-Rexes.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Animated deep sea adventure series. Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. Peso must perform an emergency fin bandage on a hungry great white shark, but first they need to subdue the giant predator using a trick called tonic immobility.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Peter learns not to judge a book by its cover when he takes an elderly tortoise for a quiet walk in the woods.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels are enjoying a day at the beach. Suddenly a great shadow comes over them as they are dwarfed by a giant, regal sailing ship that has run aground on the beach. The Squirrels go to investigate. They encounter the Penguins who explain they were on a very important mission when they got sick. They need to head to a nearby island, but they are too poorly to sail the ship. Can Duggee and the Squirrels help?

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: After a spate of unfortunate accidents, Pancake is convinced that rubbing a lucky icicle will bring him good luck but panics when it’s rubbed away, until his friends step in.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea traps Supertato and demands he tell her the secret of his superstrength. Supertato escapes and tells Evil Pea that his friends give him his strength.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy and the Ducklings come across a lost sheep and decide to look after it. When they get home, they argue over who gets to play games with their new friend.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: An old map, mysterious clues and ancient secrets... Mojo and Bo are after the treasure of the Knights of Swoppiton! But Preston’s after it too, so they need to get there first.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Coco wants to play 'wild girls' with Indy, but Chloe wants her to try another game.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It is Bluey’s first trip to the cinema, but she’s worried that the movie will be too scary. When Bingo starts running amok in the theatre, she must conquer her fear and help Dad out.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: An impatient Great Gnanna gets accidentally trapped with Gadabout in the dispensary. It’s a tense time for both of them, while Zog and Pearl race to set them free.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: Penny coaches PC Plum for the You Laugh You Lose contest against the Harbour Master. But keeping a straight face and making the Harbour Master laugh is trickier than expected.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: The pups are making their costumes for the school Halloween parade. Dodge, Jazz and Woofer choose complicated ones to make but don't use their time wisely to finish them. They have to come up with a new plan to join in the parade.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: It’s Halloween, and Rafi wants to frighten everyone. She tries costumes and tricks, but nobody is scared. So Rafi makes a wish to be a real monster, and suddenly everyone runs away!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are getting ready for a Halloween party, but when JoJo accidentally squashes their spooky pumpkin lantern, they need a replacement! Luckily Gran Gran has a Gran Gran Plan to save the day.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah and Duck visit a large department store, looking for some new toys.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: The new table Major has made collapses, spilling soup everywhere. Tiny and Small are sent off to fetch some more soup, but the soup trolley crashes into a new bump in the path on the way to the soup wells. Major finds a new use for his collapsed table.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa dress up as a happy clown, a superhero, a tiger and in silly glasses. At the Play Tree, BaBa and MeMo excitedly choose a pretty tutu to play with, but BaBa is sad when it doesn’t fit. It fits MeMo perfectly. When MeMo shrinks down for Yummy Time, MeMo feels sad that the tutu no longer fits and understands how BaBa must be feeling. MeMo finds a way for them to both play with the tutu.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Children's show about a magic place inhabited by toy characters. Travel to the night garden with Iggle Piggle to meet his friends. The smallest Pontipines and the biggest Haahoos are clean when Makka Pakka washes their faces. But the Tombliboos are especially clean, because they also have great fun cleaning their teeth.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: A different story read each night just before bedtime.
